systems.system: National Population Biometric Register and Citizen Welcome Centres
systems.country_label: Registre national biométrique des populations; Centres d'accueil des citoyens (CAC)
systems.tiers: 180 welcome centres issuing biometric civil status documents across the country's 216 communes as at June 2013, per AMI

note: Identity and civil status documents are issued at the national agency ANRPTS's own welcome centres located in the communes, not by the commune offices; the document states nothing about a connection at a commune's own office.
